mentions.name: GitHub PR Pretty Link
mentions.description: A browser extension that copies a GitHub pull request's title and link to the clipboard in GitHub's format, so it can be pasted into chat apps when asking colleagues for a review, making it clearer what a reviewer is about to look at and speeding up reviews.
mentions.problem: Manually pinging people with a raw PR link gives reviewers little context; including the PR title and link format makes it easier to understand what's being reviewed and enables quicker reviews.
mentions.audience: People sharing GitHub pull requests with colleagues for code review in chat apps.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a little browser extension to copy github pull requests into the clipboard to share them in chat apps for reviews.

evidence.value: I am working on a little browser extension to copy github pull requests into the clipboard to share them in chat apps for reviews.
